propositions: The ADR 0005-promised byte-total backstop trigger in _gc_pass was never implemented; _gc_pass reads only free-space and mtime, never consulting _cache.byte_total, leaving the store with no size-based reclaim mechanism.

materialize_tickets populates entries into the store without calling add_bytes, violating the incremental byte-accounting contract; these tickets-<sha> entries (~620 MiB each) dominate the store but contribute zero to byte_total.
A new max_bytes tunable cap on store size was added, resolved through config/env with default 0 (off), and evicts LRU-by-mtime under the grace window down to a target margin below the cap.
materialize_tickets now accounts its entries via add_bytes on the won-race branch only, mirroring cache.acquire's behavior and ensuring byte_total agrees with startup_sweep's authoritative walk.
